task_type: production admin, analytics and reliability repair
requested_outcome: Repair the public review jump, persist and report contact and booking activity accurately, deliver a usable date-filtered cross-world management system with world activation controls, remove confusing pending-page states, eliminate the observed business-page Worker failure mechanism, publish the exact candidate, and rerun full QA excluding accessibility and typography.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co business pages and the authenticated https://vii.spaplus.co/admin management surfaces
authorization_boundary: Implementation, production publication and non-destructive verification are explicitly authorized. No real customer message, call, review, booking, payment, destructive data operation or accessibility/typography audit is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request combines many related outcomes and explicitly rejects missed items.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every requirement must map to public or authenticated destination evidence, a precise blocker or an explicit exclusion.

lesson_bundle.reason: The management product and public site already contain capabilities that must be preserved.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory current data sources, controls and surfaces before replacing or consolidating them.

lesson_bundle.reason: The review row and management filters are interactive across desktop and mobile.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise click, loading, empty, error, reload and responsive states.

lesson_bundle.reason: Lead, report refresh and world-state saves are asynchronous material actions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require immediate busy state, duplicate protection and recoverable errors.

lesson_bundle.reason: Shared public and admin controls must survive viewport transitions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Run mobile, desktop, reload and breakpoint transition checks on changed surfaces.

lesson_bundle.reason: Visible public mobile behavior is part of the supplied evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require deployed mobile screenshots and live inspection for changed public UI.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request is explicitly about trustworthy operational and conversion reporting.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Separate intent from outcome, exclude internal/bot activity and label unique browsers honestly.

lesson_bundle.reason: Worlds, suppliers, bookings and place pages follow VII-specific product rules.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use VII master plan and feedback standard as project truth and test the affected world family.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A feature exists in code but the public or authenticated production destination still shows old behavior.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Freeze one candidate, publish once, verify the exact public release and reload the natural destinations.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Production release identity matches the candidate and changed flows work after reload.

predicted_rejections.rejection: WhatsApp or phone numbers are shown as completed conversations or calls instead of tracked intent.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use distinct persisted event names and plain-language labels for lead saved, chat handoff, phone reveal/click and verified booking.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Reports expose separate columns and formulas with no inflated outcome claim.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The report supports only preset days or one world and lacks opening-date versus arrival-date filtering.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add explicit from/till, date basis, world, supplier and place filters with CSV parity.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Changing each filter changes the server query and visible/exported result set.

predicted_rejections.rejection: World off hides one menu link but leaks through footer, search, homepage, cross-sells or sitemap.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Create one persisted canonical world-state source and consume it across every mapped surface.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: An inactive test world disappears from the complete mapped family and returns after reactivation without data loss.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Worker 1102 returns or business pages remain several seconds and hundreds of kilobytes unnecessarily.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Measure the route, isolate CPU/payload causes and reduce work and serialized props on the critical path.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Repeated public probes return 200 without 1102 and document size/latency materially improve or an exact external blocker is recorded.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Pending 301-backed pages remain unexplained or unmanageable.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Separate legacy redirect coverage from editorial publication status and show actionable reasons and destination state.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Admin distinguishes redirect-only, draft, review, scheduled and published records with direct actions.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A broad admin makeover breaks public search, booking, reviews, galleries or prior last-minute work.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve existing contracts, add focused tests and run the sitewide affected-family matrix before and after publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All existing regression suites plus new admin/public tests pass on the exact candidate and public release.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the first end-to-end slice persists a lead/contact event and renders it in the consolidated report, and the review row jumps correctly, before world controls and broad admin expansion.

intent and outcome labels are distinct
review summary activates the real review section

attack_questions: Can a WhatsApp handoff open without a retrievable persisted lead, or can a failed save still open WhatsApp?
Can phone reveal, phone click, VII booking and Biz booking be confused or double-counted?
Can an inactive world remain visible through any header, footer, home, search, cross-sell or sitemap surface?
Can an unauthorized user read private reports or personal lead rows?
Can business?id=vacation-2566 still produce Worker 1102, oversized HTML or a long critical-path supplier wait?
Do date-basis filters, empty states, reload and CSV preserve the same result semantics?
Did publishing overwrite the last-minute page or any previously verified public fix?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public release identity, repeated public business-page probes, live desktop/mobile review jump, and authenticated admin screenshots/API reads.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated full regression excluding accessibility and typography plus mapped public/admin world and data-source matrix.

effectiveness.baseline: Public vacation-2566 was observed once as Cloudflare Worker 1102 and later returned 200 in about 4 seconds with roughly 818 KB HTML; management exposes fragmented preset-period reports and an unstyled last-100 WhatsApp table.
effectiveness.target: One coherent, queryable and truthful admin flow; no reproducible 1102; materially lower business-page critical cost; complete world visibility control; all changed and preserved flows verified on the published release.
